# agentic-treg

Route live data through a catalog with a CLI, npm library, and MCP server.

Library: searchCatalog, getEndpoint, callEndpoint, getBalance, doctor.
CLI: search, get, call, balance, doctor, mcp.
MCP: treg_search, treg_get, treg_call, treg_doctor.
Calls default to dry run with no network activity.
Live calls require explicit execution and read prices first.
Anonymous access works where the service allows it.
Use TREG_TOKEN for authentication.
Use TREG_ORG_ID for explicit balance organization selection.
Custom result data is capped at 4000 UTF-8 bytes.
HTTP and vendor failures throw shared core VendorError.

Docs: https://github.com/pooriaarab/agentic-treg
API: https://treg.to/llms.txt
License: MIT
